spec.strategy: Avellaneda & Lee (2010) sector-ETF residual mean reversion
spec.reference: Avellaneda, M. and Lee, J.-H. (2010), Statistical Arbitrage in the U.S. Equities Market, Quantitative Finance 10(7):761-782; equation numbers of the 15 June 2009 draft
spec.signal: pure mean-reversion s-score, Sec. 4.1 eq. (15), s = -(m - <m>)/sigma_eq with the cross-sectionally centred mean of Sec. 5.1 eq. (18) / Appendix eq. (22); <m> over the day's universe members with an accepted model. Not the drift-adjusted eq. (17).
spec.estimation: 60-day OLS of stock on sector-ETF returns with intercept; AR(1) by OLS on the cumulative residual; kappa = -ln(b)*252, m = a/(1-b), sigma_eq = sqrt(Var(zeta)/(1-b^2)) (Appendix eq. 21); accepted iff 0 < b < 1 and kappa > 252/30
spec.rules: open long s < -1.25, open short s > 1.25, close long s > -0.50, close short s < 0.75 (Sec. 4.1 eq. 16); close when a held model is rejected (Sec. 5); no estimate: keep state
spec.execution: signal at the close of t, fill at the close of t+1, shares fixed from the t close; stock notional position_frac x equity hedged with -beta x notional of the sector ETF, ETF hedges netted daily
spec.costs: S1's cost model (profile v33): transaction_costs.calculate_leg_cost per stock execution (20-day dollar ADV and volatility at the fill) + borrow on short stock legs; net ETF trades through the same function at ETF_ASSUMED_ADV_DOLLARS (top spread bucket, impact ~0) + borrow on net short ETF positions
spec.universe: S1's rule: on each ranking day (the first signal day, then every universe_rebalance_days) the point-in-time members in force that day (the IWV snapshot) with price history, screened as S1 screens a formation on the trailing universe_window_days (pair_selector.screen_symbols: >= 300 bars, mean point-in-time close >= $5 and dollar volume >= $10M, annualised volatility 5-80%, < 10% missing closes); the universe_size most liquid screened names with a sector ETF; without a membership source, every name of the price dict

shares_with_profile.name: v33
shares_with_profile.what: point-in-time universe rule, t+1 close fills, cost model

universe.source: point-in-time Russell 3000 membership, IWV N-PORT holdings (universe.PITUniverse)
